summary_en: This study compares two safety margins of surgical removal, 1 cm and 2 cm, for stage II primary cutaneous melanoma. The surgery removes a 1 cm or 2 cm margin of skin and is done on the same day as a sentinel lymph node biopsy. The main outcome measured is disease-free survival.
summary_es: Este estudio compara dos márgenes de seguridad de extirpación quirúrgica, de 1 cm y de 2 cm, para el melanoma cutáneo primario en etapa II. La cirugía retira un margen de piel de 1 cm o 2 cm y se realiza el mismo día que la biopsia de ganglio centinela. La medida principal es la supervivencia libre de enfermedad.
who_for: Stage II primary invasive cutaneous melanoma, with Breslow thickness and ulceration criteria as stated in the record
Melanoma on the head, neck, trunk, extremity, scalp, palm or sole
A 2 cm margin around the biopsy scar or melanoma must be technically feasible
Surgery completed within 120 days of diagnosis and within 28 days of randomisation
Age 18 or older, able to give informed consent, ECOG performance score 0 to 1, life expectancy of at least 5 years
not_for: Uncertain melanoma diagnosis, such as a melanocytic lesion of unknown malignant potential
Perineural invasion or neurotropic melanoma, or pure desmoplastic melanoma
Subungual melanoma or melanoma at excluded sites such as the nose tip, eyelids, ear, genitalia or mucous membranes
Physical, clinical, radiographic or pathologic evidence of metastatic, satellite or in-transit melanoma
Other solid tumour or blood cancer in the past 5 years, with stated exceptions for some skin cancers and uterine or cervical cancer
